name: Suzuki Co.,Ltd.
summary: Suzuki Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells connectors for car electronics parts in Japan. It offers precision press and mold dies, connector contacts and housings, connector contacts for automotive wire harnesses, machines for semiconductor later process, various customized machines, and medical instrument assembly products. It is also involved in die manufacturing, component manufacturing, product system manufacturing, technical development, quality assurance businesses, as well as rents and sells electricity Suzuki Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1933 and is headquartered in Suzaka, Japan.
